inspection_record.method: Personally opened original512px bottom-lit ventral clean-import exactGLB frame. Original darker ventral attempt retained separately. Supplemental view does NOT replace any eight canonical views.
inspection_record.observation: Personally inspected all8 final individual512px frames and lossless sheet. Complete shallow soft disc has continuous upper/lower volume, fine shallow radial subdivisions and irregular soft rim. Flush C-shaped ochre teaching projection has broad stomach arc and narrow terminal intestine swept clockwise in +Z dorsal view. It is a deliberate internal-anatomy annotation, not naturally external gut or realistic skin pigment. No marginal jellyfish curtain, stalk or modern jellyfish inference. Two short oral ventral branched trunks visible below disc in front/rear/side. Separate bottom-lit ventral diagnostic personally inspected: two branched feeding tentacles arise together at off-centre ventral mouth; separate nearby small dark ventral anus. Fine exact thickness/branching/colors are inferred. Affinity/ecology uncertainties retained. Projection has polygonal stylized boundary, intentionally not specimen-level anatomy. Original r001 mechanical projection retained and r002 actually rendered anew.
